label: possessives with one possessor: maazaa, tuzaa, tyaachaa
note: Real, and no longer a measurement artefact. maazhaM has an atom of its own (MR-LEX-MAJHE, chapter 9, now schema-v2) and MR-GRAMMAR-POSSESSIVE-THREE-GENDERS states its gender agreement. What no lesson supplies is the PARADIGM: the learner can change the thing possessed and cannot change the POSSESSOR, because tuzaa and tyaachaa have no exponent anywhere.
